storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
Draped in shimmering jewels and trailing gossamer silk, she keeps her true self hidden beneath a facade of breathtaking splendor.

Thais may appear vain and frivolous—an impression held by many—but perhaps that is merely another mask she wears.

"My, what are you writing there? Here, let me help—

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
The flood that swept across the world washed away the treasures of civilization, but it also cleared the dust from history's pages.

When the waters finally receded, fragments of a forgotten past surfaced among the ruins of ancient Morsul.

The "Tree" stood at the Karage River's source, weeping crimson sap that flowed downstream to nurture civilizations.

The "Tree" was undying, ever-verdant through the ages.

Ultimately, modern historians concluded that the "Tree" had no physical form; rather, It was a metaphor for ancient civilization, a sacred, incorporeal symbol.

In every unseen corner of the world, its seeds have quietly taken root.

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
Mythag awakens and contains many Awakeners, but none are as unique as Thais.

She helps schoolgirls pick out makeup for dates; she helps the disheartened regain hope, and she helps investigators on the verge of mental collapse find their way back to the light.

She's like a lover, a sister, or above all, a mother. She has a gift for creating a quagmire called "love", quietly drawing people in and making them unconsciously willing to give everything for her—
Following the third intervention to prevent a student from drinking the mysterious liquid she provided, the Awakener Management Office issued a restriction order against her.

"Thais is strictly prohibited from approaching any student unless accompanied by the Keeper."

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
The name @2 appears time and again upon the pages of history.

Priestess. Mother. Queen. Sorceress. Too many titles have been attached to this name, leaving scholars unable to determine which one truly defines the Awakener we know today.

Thais herself does not hesitate to share her past with us—all of it is her, yet none of it is entirely her.

"It was she who was born of noble blood."

Thais was always the most radiant girl in the temple. As the child of the High Priest, she moved with a fluid grace and carried the gentle warmth of moonlight.

"It was she who knelt before the Tree."

Thais was the vibrant leaf on the "Tree"; her devotion had earned her the blessings of It.

"It was she who was bled dry."

When cataclysm struck and the pillars of civilization crumbled, the ancient, ignorant civilization chose her—their most exceptional daughter.

"It was she whose veins now pulse with crimson sap."

The "Tree" revered by all made its own choice. Its branches took root within her, granting her a near-eternal life.

"But it was not she who wished to destroy civilization."

The annihilation of the world was never what Thais desired.

"But Miss Thais, what do you truly desire?"

"My dear, didn't we agree? When our bond bears fruit, you will have your answer."

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
It truly exists.

It is the gaze cast by God, the branch God extends towards the universe.

It delights in the grandeur of history and hungers for the flourishing of civilization.

It seeks to transcend withering, to surpass death itself.

She longs for low, resonant chants, for dust and salt-laden winds, for silver leaves and the moonlight over Morsul.

Fiend, witch, sorceress... the judgments of mortals are mere trifles.

If even a single drop of blood escapes the black encroachment, They shall once more draw eternity into Their arms.

daily.title: Awaken
daily.content: My veins surge with the will to survive, screaming and driving me to spill my blood on every inch of this planet... Ah, I've rambled on for too long; do forgive me. I am Thais. Have you summoned me? Are you ready to merge with me?

daily.title: Upgrade: I
daily.content: Thank you for your efforts. Allow me to reward you in kind.

daily.title: Upgrade: II
daily.content: My body is getting warmer.

daily.title: Upgrade: III
daily.content: Your generosity is greatly cherished...

daily.title: Enlighten: Observe
daily.content: Would you like to touch it? My heart beats because of your presence.

daily.title: Enlighten: Ponder
daily.content: I'm so happy... You're so biased and favor me so much.

daily.title: Enlighten: Reflect
daily.content: Others may get upset if they think you're showing favoritism.

daily.title: Enlighten: Insight
daily.content: Do you long for me as well?

daily.title: Enlighten: Elevate
daily.content: Is this the manifestation of your desire, to deepen my affection?

daily.title: Enlighten: Florish
daily.content: For all that you have given me, your love has already become one with mine...

daily.title: Affinity: I
daily.content: Why not lose yourself in my love? Didn't you awaken me for the warmth of my embrace?

daily.title: Affinity: II
daily.content: Why do you always avoid me? Are you shy? How cute, this reluctance to face your desires.

daily.title: Affinity: III
daily.content: Hmm? You're wary of me, a woman of unknown origins? Very well... I was the deposed queen of Nineveh, the Shinarite who clawed at heaven's gate, and the girl who had her consciousness stolen beneath Euphrates' sacred bough... Where shall I begin, my wary one?

daily.title: Affinity: IV
daily.content: Since I am Awakened as your apostle, I seek nothing but your peace and joy, that is my wish... Ugh... Ahh... Yes, yes, I wish for survival, perseverance, reproduction, we must live on, LIVE ON...

daily.title: Affinity: V
daily.content: I have always awaited the arrival of destruction, never considering "resistance"... Will you help my shallow soul cross the abyss? Even in a world where I narrowly survived, you still grant me salvation...

daily.title: Chat: Touch
daily.content: Oh dear, are you being affectionate with me? This is troublesome. If this continues, I won't be able to wait until you fully mature, my dear {Male=Mr.,Female=Miss} Keeper...

daily.title: Chat: About Past
daily.content: To survive annihilation, I've shared my spirit and blood with too many. My power now is a ghost of what it was when I first embraced this Supreme Will...

daily.title: Chat: About Salvador
daily.content: I'm not good at dealing with clerics. They're dull and rigid, and they've given their belts to their beloved "God". Such a pity, Mr. Salvador smells so sweet...

daily.title: Chat: About Lotan
daily.content: I can sense that girl's hostility; my love for you has lit the fire of her jealousy... Look, even that humpback whale gapes with envy.

daily.title: Chat: About Dissolution
daily.content: What filth, what abomination! Ah—stop it! Please! Don't make me see it, don't speak of it near me...

daily.title: Chat: About Mythag
daily.content: Oh dear, most here are still children. That white-haired gentleman, the stern one-armed youth—none of them are ideal for children... Sigh, this is quite a dilemma.

daily.title: Chat: What I Like
daily.content: Have you seen those ancient stone carvings? Merged with mountains, enduring through time, such wonderful relics... but they still don't last long enough...

daily.title: Chat: What I Hate
daily.content: Human faces twisted by desire never cease to amuse. So fragile, so small... This alone makes me feel as if a cat were scratching at my heart..

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper
daily.content: You truly are a dishonest child. Lucky for you, I have eternity to wait...

daily.title: Chat: About Alva
daily.content: She's an overcautious child. Not that I blame her—without her, my free-spirited people would've perished long ago, no?

daily.title: Chat: About Tawil
daily.content: Oh dear, I've lost to her this time... But since she chose you, you'll drink the Holy Tree's sap and carry my blood and seeds to a new world, yes?

daily.title: Chat: About Ryker
daily.content: That wolf-boy... Did you know? He and that N have something... indescribable, going on between them.

daily.title: Chat: About Jenkin
daily.content: Oh dear, a little mouse scurried past... They love nibbling forbidden things, don't they? But this one's still much too young.

daily.title: Chat: About Erica
daily.content: All conscious beings have desires. Even machines, yes?

daily.title: Chat: About Agrippa
daily.content: Spiders... Mmm~ I adore them. They are born walking and fertile beyond envy...

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper - 2
daily.content: I'll teach you pleasure, the thrill of riding that high... In return, you will bare your desires to me.

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper - 3
daily.unlockCondition: Unlocks after completing Main Story Chapter 7
daily.content: Come closer. Embrace me. Taste me... Never forget me.

daily.title: Chat: About Aram
daily.unlockCondition: Unlocks after completing Main Story Chapter 7
daily.content: They carried my blood, my lineage, becoming the flourishing waters of Remouahe... Now, my dear, you must see my legacy endure.

daily.title: Chat: About The Mother Tree
daily.unlockCondition: Unlocks after completing Main Story Chapter 7
daily.content: I am the Mother Tree. The Mother Tree is me. Her sap flows in my veins, her will whispers in my mind...

daily.title: Chat: About "N"
daily.content: That one, of the three Aeons, is a monster wrapped in riddles. Please don't let his honeyed words sway you, or I'll be heartbroken...

daily.title: Chat: About Desire
daily.content: All desires sprout from love; love is the seed before the towering tree of fertility.

daily.title: Chat: About Keygrave
daily.unlockCondition: Unlocks after completing Main Story Chapter 7
daily.content: I glimpsed your tombstone in Keygrave's shadows... Will my mummified flesh rest here too, one day? No? What a pity.

daily.title: Chat: About Offsprings
daily.unlockCondition: Unlocks after completing Main Story Chapter 7
daily.content: Those with the flowing tree's blood are my children—you, who've swallowed its seeds are of course included.

daily.title: Chat: About the Desert
daily.content: Born from the yellow sands, and to the yellow sands you shall return. On this brief journey, shouldn't you leave some souvenirs along the way? Sow some seeds?

battle.title: Investigation Begins
battle.content: After the victory, please allow me to take the materials needed for reproduction.

battle.title: Investigation Success
battle.content: Is it over already? ... My excitement was just beginning to stir.

battle.title: Skill: II
battle.content: Aw, am I causing you pain?

battle.title: Exalt
battle.content: Grow and thrive, my little sapling.

battle.title: Over-Exalt
battle.content: Join my ritual and become my seed!
